noble.name: Szlachcic
noble.blurb: A landed noble of the Wisniowiecki client families. Estate near Bochnia, now under Austrian audit. Salon door open, Sejm memories fresh.
noble.weakness: Family estate can be seized; relatives taken as hostages.
noble.goal: Restore the Constitution of 3 May with yourself as its guardian.

artist.name: Bohemian Artist
artist.blurb: A painter and pamphleteer. Broke, notorious, adored by students and printers, tolerated by hostesses. Owes money to men who collect.
artist.weakness: Scandal and debt. One good rumour ends you.
artist.goal: A republic of citizens, with no king at all.

veteran.name: Peasant Veteran
veteran.blurb: A scytheman from Raclawice, 1794. No papers, no land, one good arm. The men who fought beside you still know your name.
veteran.weakness: No papers. A patrol stop means conscription or the rope.
veteran.goal: Land to those who work it. Freedom from the lords as much as the Austrians.

merchant.name: Guild Burgher
merchant.blurb: Cloth merchant with a stall in the Sukiennice and a warehouse on the Vistula. Knows every customs man, and which ones drink.
merchant.weakness: Ledgers can be audited; goods and warehouse seized.
merchant.goal: A commonwealth of towns, not just of nobles.

priest.name: Parish Priest
priest.blurb: Curate at St Mary's. Hears the confessions of half the Rynek. The Bishop finds you useful, for now.
priest.weakness: The Bishop can silence or transfer you at a word.
priest.goal: A Catholic commonwealth restored, its church free of Vienna.

kazimierz.name: Kazimierz Merchant
kazimierz.blurb: A financier from Kazimierz with correspondents in Breslau and Lwow. Excluded from the council, indispensable to it.
kazimierz.weakness: Legal restrictions. Rivals can turn a crowd against your quarter.
kazimierz.goal: A commonwealth with equal law for all its peoples.
